MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GUANYU.NAME: Guan Yu
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GUANYU.LAST_DEED: Surrounded at Maicheng, he left the city to break through, and was ambushed and captured on the road.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GUANYU.MEMORY_1: There was a man I called elder brother. For that one name I took the long road back.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GUANYU.MEMORY_2: The blade was heavy. People feared me, and still looked up to me.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GUANYU.MEMORY_3: That night I tried to break through. This time, in your body, I walk that road to its end.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GUANYU.TASK: Deal 30+ damage to an enemy with a single attack
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.JOAN.NAME: Joan of Arc
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.JOAN.SHADOW: A word not taken back, even in the fire
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.JOAN.LAST_DEED: She took back the abjuration she had signed out of fear of the fire, days later. On 30 May 1431 she was burned at Rouen.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.JOAN.MEMORY_1: I first heard the voices in my father's garden. No one believed me, but I heard them.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.JOAN.MEMORY_2: I carried the banner into the city. The siege was lifted.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.JOAN.MEMORY_3: Before the fire I kept my word. I will not take it back this time either.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.LEONIDAS.NAME: Leonidas
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.LEONIDAS.SHADOW: The pass held, the home never reached
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.LEONIDAS.LAST_DEED: When the Persians came round behind by the mountain path, he sent most of the allies away and stayed at Thermopylae with those who remained (480 BC).
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.LEONIDAS.MEMORY_1: The shield was never for me. It was for the man standing beside me.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.LEONIDAS.MEMORY_2: In a narrow pass, it is the line that fights, not the numbers.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.LEONIDAS.MEMORY_3: I did not turn back. I do not turn back now.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.LEONIDAS.TASK: Block a total of 50+ damage in one combat
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GENGHIS.NAME: Genghis Khan
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GENGHIS.LAST_DEED: He died in 1227, during the campaign against Western Xia. The campaign was not yet over.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GENGHIS.MEMORY_1: There was a child on the steppe who lost everything. That child decided never to lose again.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GENGHIS.MEMORY_2: I bound the scattered tribes into one. The horses never rested.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GENGHIS.MEMORY_3: The campaign is not finished. Tread its end with your own feet.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.YISUNSIN.NAME: Yi Sun-sin
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.YISUNSIN.SHADOW: A sea not yet at peace
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.YISUNSIN.LAST_DEED: At Noryang (1598), struck by a bullet, he is said to have ordered: "The battle is at its height. Do not announce my death."
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.YISUNSIN.MEMORY_1: It was people, not ships, who guarded the sea. Every day I kept a diary.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.YISUNSIN.MEMORY_2: The enemy was many and our ships were few. Still, we did not give way.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.YISUNSIN.MEMORY_3: I fell before the battle ended. This time I will see the end.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.YISUNSIN.TASK: Win an Elite or Boss combat at 50% HP or less
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.NAPOLEON.NAME: Napoleon
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.NAPOLEON.LAST_DEED: After Waterloo he was exiled to Saint Helena, and died there on 5 May 1821.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.NAPOLEON.MEMORY_1: I was born on a small island. The world was always larger than the island.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.NAPOLEON.MEMORY_2: Deciding where to place the guns was deciding the battle.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.NAPOLEON.MEMORY_3: It ended on an island. This time, I leave the island.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.CONTRACT_TEXT.RESONANCE: A soul that walked the same road. Synchronization and Focus need less Mastery.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.CONTRACT_TEXT.GRUDGE: A soul mixed with another grain. Start each combat with 1 [gold]Strength[/gold], but cards that are not your figure's build [gold]Grudge[/gold].
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.STATUS.HEAD: [gold]{Figure}[/gold] · {Contract} · {Stage}
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.STATUS.READY: [gold]{Stage}[/gold] is ready. The reel waits to turn.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.STATUS.COMPLETE: You and the soul are one.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PROMPT.GAZE: The last second. Where does your [gold]gaze[/gold] go?
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PROMPT.ACTION: A frozen second. What do you [gold]do[/gold]?
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PROMPT.WORDS: Last words. The [gold]words[/gold] you never said aloud.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.DESC: You were leading people across a collapsing bridge. It buckles, and fire rises behind you.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at the companion who stayed by your side
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the sky beyond the smoke
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at those who have not crossed yet
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at the land waiting across the river
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the children still on the bridge
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You count how long the bridge will hold
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.ACTION.GUANYU: You turn back; you will not leave your companion
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.ACTION.JOAN: You keep to your path though they shout for you to stop
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You stand at the edge and hold the breaking side with your body
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.ACTION.GENGHIS: You race ahead, faster than the fire
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You hide that you have fallen and shout, "Do not stop!"
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You judge where it will fall and send them the other way
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.WORDS.GUANYU: "There is no road that leaves a brother behind."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.WORDS.JOAN: "I will not deny what I heard."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.WORDS.LEONIDAS: "Until you are across, I stay here."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BRIDGE.WORDS.YISUNSIN: "Do not tell them I have fallen."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SIEGE.DESC: The last night of a besieged fortress. The gate is cracked and the arrows are gone. At dawn it ends.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SIEGE.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at the comrade you swore with
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SIEGE.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the banner on the wall
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SIEGE.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at the cracked gate
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SIEGE.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look past the enemy camp
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SIEGE.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the people inside the walls
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SIEGE.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You search for the gap in the enemy torches
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SIEGE.ACTION.GUANYU: You carry your comrade and break the encirclement
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SIEGE.ACTION.JOAN: You tear up the terms of surrender
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SIEGE.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You stand alone before the gate
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SIEGE.ACTION.GENGHIS: You gather the horses and charge into the enemy camp
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SIEGE.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You light the last fire to show the people the way out
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SIEGE.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You send a few through the gap to strike the enemy's back
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SIEGE.WORDS.NAPOLEON: "Victory belongs to the one who planned it."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.DESC: A storm at sea. The mast is broken and the ship lists. There is only one lifeboat.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at your comrade in the water
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the light breaking through the clouds
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at the sailors still aboard
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at the horizon beyond the storm
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the people clinging to the deck
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You read the direction of the wind
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.ACTION.GUANYU: You throw a rope and pull your comrade up
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.ACTION.JOAN: You take the helm that everyone abandoned
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You give your place in the lifeboat to another
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.ACTION.GENGHIS: You grip the torn sail and drive against the waves
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You get the people off the sinking ship until the end
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You give the ship to the wind and drive it ashore
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.WORDS.GUANYU: "I will not let go of your hand."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.WORDS.GENGHIS: "The sea is a road as well."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.WORDS.YISUNSIN: "Our ships are still on the sea."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.STORM.WORDS.NAPOLEON: "The wind is already on my side."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TEMPLE.DESC: A burning temple. The roof is falling in, and people are still trapped inside.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TEMPLE.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at the one who followed you in
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TEMPLE.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the lamp the fire has not put out
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TEMPLE.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at the falling pillar
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TEMPLE.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at the path the fire is taking
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TEMPLE.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the people trapped inside
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TEMPLE.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You look for a window to escape through
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TEMPLE.ACTION.GUANYU: You push the one who came with you out first
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TEMPLE.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You hold up the pillar with your shoulder
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TEMPLE.ACTION.GENGHIS: You outrun the fire and break the wall
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TEMPLE.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You carry them out, down to the last one
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TEMPLE.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You bring down a wall to block the fire and open a way
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TEMPLE.WORDS.GENGHIS: "If there is no road, I make one."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SCAFFOLD.DESC: The square before the scaffold. The crowd roars. Take back a single word, they say, and you will live.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SCAFFOLD.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at an old comrade hidden in the crowd
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SCAFFOLD.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the cross above the scaffold
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SCAFFOLD.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at those weeping for you
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SCAFFOLD.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at the horse tied at the edge of the square
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SCAFFOLD.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the frightened children
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SCAFFOLD.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You study the faces of those who judged you
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SCAFFOLD.ACTION.GUANYU: You signal your comrade not to come
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SCAFFOLD.ACTION.JOAN: You take back not a single word
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SCAFFOLD.ACTION.LEONIDA: You ask them to free the others in exchange for your life
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SCAFFOLD.ACTION.GENGHIS: You cut the rope and leap onto the horse
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SCAFFOLD.ACTION.NAPOLEO: You point out the flaw in the verdict and set them against each other
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SCAFFOLD.WORDS.GENGHIS: "There is no rope that holds me."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SNOWMARCH.DESC: A march through snowbound mountains. The road is buried, soldiers fall one by one. Turn back, and you live.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SNOWMARCH.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at the comrade fallen in the snow
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SNOWMARCH.GAZE.JOAN: You look at a single star between the clouds
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SNOWMARCH.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at the soldiers behind you
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SNOWMARCH.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at the plain beyond the pass
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SNOWMARCH.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the young soldier freezing
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SNOWMARCH.ACTION.GUANYU: You carry your comrade and keep walking
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SNOWMARCH.ACTION.JOAN: Everyone turns back; you walk on alone at the front
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SNOWMARCH.ACTION.LEONID: You take the rear and guard the stragglers
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SNOWMARCH.ACTION.GENGHI: You cross the pass by the fastest route
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SNOWMARCH.ACTION.YISUNS: You put your coat over the young soldier
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SNOWMARCH.ACTION.NAPOLE: You abandon the baggage and reorder the march
MUMYEONG-THEATER.SNOWMARCH.WORDS.GENGHIS: "What lies beyond the pass is ours."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.DESC: A flooded village. The dike has burst and the water reaches the roofs. There is one boat.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at the friend on the roof
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the bell ringing in the tower
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at the broken dike
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at the field where the water could drain
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the people being swept away
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You read the flow of the water
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.ACTION.GUANYU: You row to your friend first
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.ACTION.JOAN: You ring the bell to wake everyone
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You throw yourself against the broken dike
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.ACTION.GENGHIS: You break another dike to turn the water
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You give the boat to the people and swim
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You choose the high ground and move people in order
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.WORDS.GENGHIS: "Even water can be made to yield."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FLOOD.WORDS.NAPOLEON: "Chaos is only the absence of a plan."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.WELL.DESC: A desert well. There is water enough for one, and thirsty people stand all around.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.WELL.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at your thirsty comrade
MUMYEONG-THEATER.WELL.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the sunlight on the sand
MUMYEONG-THEATER.WELL.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at the people about to collapse
MUMYEONG-THEATER.WELL.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at signs of an oasis beyond the dunes
MUMYEONG-THEATER.WELL.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at a child's cracked lips
MUMYEONG-THEATER.WELL.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You measure the depth of the well
MUMYEONG-THEATER.WELL.ACTION.GUANYU: You hand the water to your comrade
MUMYEONG-THEATER.WELL.ACTION.JOAN: You do not drink; you pray
MUMYEONG-THEATER.WELL.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You share your portion among everyone
MUMYEONG-THEATER.WELL.ACTION.GENGHIS: You take the strongest and ride for the oasis
MUMYEONG-THEATER.WELL.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You give the child water first
MUMYEONG-THEATER.WELL.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You set the order and the measure of the water
MUMYEONG-THEATER.WELL.WORDS.NAPOLEON: "What we lack is not water but order."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.MINE.DESC: A collapsing mine. The exit is blocked and the last lamp is dying. There is a narrow crack above.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.MINE.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at the comrade pinned under the rock
MUMYEONG-THEATER.MINE.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the dying lamp
MUMYEONG-THEATER.MINE.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at the last beam holding the tunnel
MUMYEONG-THEATER.MINE.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at the narrow crack above
MUMYEONG-THEATER.MINE.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the miners struggling to breathe
MUMYEONG-THEATER.MINE.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You judge the order in which the rock will fall
MUMYEONG-THEATER.MINE.ACTION.GUANYU: You lift the rock off your comrade with bare hands
MUMYEONG-THEATER.MINE.ACTION.JOAN: You take the lamp and lead into the dark
MUMYEONG-THEATER.MINE.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You put your back where the beam was
MUMYEONG-THEATER.MINE.ACTION.GENGHIS: You widen the crack and climb out first
MUMYEONG-THEATER.MINE.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You push the miners up through the crack one by one
MUMYEONG-THEATER.MINE.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You bring down the weak side on purpose to open a new way
MUMYEONG-THEATER.MINE.WORDS.YISUNSIN: "One at a time. Do not rush."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.DESC: A gate in a time of plague. The sick are inside, refugees outside. Open the gate, and the sickness may spread.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at an old comrade who has fallen ill
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the holy image above the gate
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at the soldiers guarding the gate
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at the road beyond the gate
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the refugees crying outside
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You trace the order in which the sickness spread
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.ACTION.GUANYU: You stay by your comrade and tend to them
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.ACTION.JOAN: You take the hand of the sick one everyone avoids
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You stand at the gate and bear the risk alone
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.ACTION.GENGHIS: You open the gate and lead everyone to other lands
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You let the refugees in and take the responsibility
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You build a camp outside and separate the sick
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.WORDS.GUANYU: "I cannot live by leaving a comrade."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.PLAGUE.WORDS.NAPOLEON: "Divide it, and it can be ruled."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BORDER.DESC: A border bridge at night. The pursuers' torches draw near. Cut the bridge, and your own side cannot cross either.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BORDER.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at your brother on the far side
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BORDER.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the moon in the dark river
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BORDER.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at the soldiers still on the bridge
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BORDER.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look past the pursuers to the enemy's main army
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BORDER.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the line of refugees crossing
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BORDER.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You count the torches to judge the pursuers
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BORDER.ACTION.GUANYU: You hold the bridge until your brother crosses
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BORDER.ACTION.JOAN: You stand in the middle of the bridge and block the way
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BORDER.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You send everyone across and cut the bridge alone
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BORDER.ACTION.GENGHIS: You cross back and fall upon the pursuers
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BORDER.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You cut the bridge only after the last refugee crosses
MUMYEONG-THEATER.BORDER.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You time exactly when to set the bridge on fire
MUMYEONG-THEATER.CORONATION.DESC: The eve of a coronation. Rebel blades approach through the cathedral crypt. The crown still rests on the altar.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.CORONATION.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at the one who trusted and followed you
MUMYEONG-THEATER.CORONATION.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the light of the stained glass
MUMYEONG-THEATER.CORONATION.GAZE.LEONIDA: You look at the narrow crypt passage
MUMYEONG-THEATER.CORONATION.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at the map of the continent beyond the crown
MUMYEONG-THEATER.CORONATION.GAZE.YISUNSI: You look at the people gathered in the cathedral
MUMYEONG-THEATER.CORONATION.GAZE.NAPOLEO: You look at the crown on the altar
MUMYEONG-THEATER.CORONATION.ACTION.GUANY: You stand back to back with your follower and raise your blade
MUMYEONG-THEATER.CORONATION.ACTION.JOAN: You raise the banner, not the crown
MUMYEONG-THEATER.CORONATION.ACTION.LEONI: You hold the narrow passage against the rebels
MUMYEONG-THEATER.CORONATION.ACTION.GENGH: You drive the rebels all the way out of the cathedral
MUMYEONG-THEATER.CORONATION.ACTION.YISUN: You get the people to safety first
MUMYEONG-THEATER.CORONATION.ACTION.NAPOL: You place the crown on your own head
MUMYEONG-THEATER.CORONATION.WORDS.NAPOLE: "The crown lay on the floor. I merely picked it up."
MUMYEONG-THEATER_EVENT.title: The Underworld Projection Room
MUMYEONG-THEATER_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.des:
Blackout.
Your heart beats twice.

[gold]You will die in one second.[/gold]

...The whir of a projector. Three shadows sit in the dark seats. Their names cannot be seen; above each floats only what they carry.
{Shadows}
MUMYEONG-THEATER_EVENT.pages.DESCENT.des:
{Reaction}The film stops. The shadow of [gold]"{Shadow}"[/gold] rises from its seat.
It walks into the screen, and its name is revealed.

[gold]{Figure}[/gold]
MUMYEONG-THEATER_EVENT.pages.DESCENT.opt: Your last second and theirs are screened side by side.
MUMYEONG-THEATER_EVENT.pages.REVEAL.opti: Make the contract. Their 2 cards join your deck, and you learn one of their techniques.
Your heart beats again. But now the beat belongs to two.
[gold]{Figure}[/gold] — {Contract}
MUMYEONG-THEATER_EVENT.pages.NO_CORE.des: The film snapped. The seats are empty.
MUMYEONG-STAGE_UP_EVENT.title: The Next Reel
MUMYEONG-STAGE_UP_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.de:
Somewhere, a projector starts again. One cut of [gold]{Figure}[/gold]'s memory appears on the screen.

"{Memory}"

The soul steps one stage deeper — [gold]{Stage}[/gold].
MUMYEONG-STAGE_UP_EVENT.pages.NOTHING.de: The projector is silent. It is not yet time for the next reel.
MUMYEONG-STAGE_UP_EVENT.pages.DONE.descr: The reel ran to its end. You and [gold]{Figure}[/gold] reached [gold]{Stage}[/gold].
